description: Updates wait out a week before Renovate proposes them, so a compromised release has time to be pulled before it reaches a PR here.

packageRules.description: One PR per service, since each tag is repeated across several workflows and compose files.

The shipped image installs valkey from Alpine's package repo, currently the 9.0 line. Hold the test pins there so they keep matching what users run, and raise this bound deliberately when ALPINE_VERSION in docker/Dockerfile moves.

customManagers.description: Image tags built at runtime in workflow steps, marked with a renovate comment. Legs deliberately left unmarked stay pinned.
The Trunk plugins release in .trunk/trunk.yaml, which no built-in manager reads. The CLI version publishes no release dates, so minimumReleaseAge can't gate it and it stays a manual bump.
